separation_contract.promotion_rule: Space admission requires its own solid-state vacuum, thermal-vacuum, active-program radiation, and mission-input gates; aqueous PEDOT results cannot fill them.

materials.inert_electrode: nickel or platinum selected before fabrication and held constant within a cohort
materials.reservoir: finite patterned silver film plus measured photodoped silver
materials.oxidation: Ag to Ag+ at the active electrode; reverse bias dissolves the bridge
materials.passivation: ALD alumina or silicon nitride cap with hermetic coupon seal and gold-capped external contact

interfaces.electrical: guarded source-measure and pulse measurement units with independent current compliance
interfaces.optical_fabrication: violet exposure through fused silica for calibrated Ag photodoping
interfaces.optical_operation: blue photodiode or micro-LED address converted into a bounded electrical set pulse; direct light steering of the buried filament is not claimed
interfaces.vacuum: temperature-controlled vacuum probe station with chamber gauge and residual gas analyzer
interfaces.radiation: calibrated cobalt-60 dosimetry with separate active-program and unbiased-retention groups

provenance.text: Large first-coupon footprint selected for probing and post-test cross-sectioning before nanoscale reduction.

hard_stop.condition: Measured width is outside range.
hard_stop.action: Exclude the cell from matched electrical and reservoir calculations.

provenance.text: Square first-coupon footprint makes reservoir mass and current-density comparisons explicit.

hard_stop.condition: Measured height is outside range.
hard_stop.action: Exclude the cell from matched electrical and reservoir calculations.

provenance.text: Starting active-electrode thickness used to create a finite, weighable Ag reservoir.

hard_stop.condition: Metrology places Ag thickness outside range.
hard_stop.action: Reject the coupon before photodoping.

provenance.text: First-coupon Ge30Se70 thickness chosen to retain a measurable solid electrolyte while remaining in established thin-film PMC practice.

hard_stop.condition: Metrology places electrolyte thickness outside range or finds pinholes.
hard_stop.action: Reject the coupon before electrical forming.

provenance.text: Mechanically robust probe electrode for the first coupon; material is fixed per cohort.

hard_stop.condition: Metrology places inert-electrode thickness outside range.
hard_stop.action: Reject the coupon before electrical forming.

provenance.text: Midpoint of the proposed ALD cap screen; cap chemistry and thickness remain a controlled fabrication factor.

hard_stop.condition: Cap is outside range, delaminated, cracked, or blocks the internal Ag-electrolyte interface.
hard_stop.action: Reject the coupon from vacuum screening.

provenance.text: Coupon array size supplies separate matched environmental and endpoint-analysis groups.
Coupon array size supplies separate matched environmental and endpoint-analysis groups.
NIST reference density for bulk silver near room temperature.
Derived upper-bound mass from cell area, Ag film thickness, and bulk density before subtracting photodoped material.

hard_stop.condition: Inferred deposited or migrated Ag exceeds the measured starting inventory.
hard_stop.action: Reject the mass model and inspect thickness, area, contamination, and cross-section measurements.

provenance.text: Authoritative room-temperature bulk reference; not assigned to a nanoscale filament.

hard_stop.condition: A report assigns this bulk value to an unmeasured filament cross-section.
hard_stop.action: Withhold conductivity and report conductance only until TEM geometry is available.

provenance.text: Low-bias state read chosen to limit filament modification.

hard_stop.condition: Read command exceeds the maximum.
hard_stop.action: Abort the read and mark it potentially state-altering.

provenance.text: Closely related Ag/Ag-Ge-S/W cells demonstrated cycling below this voltage; used only as the first sweep bound.

hard_stop.condition: Positive sweep reaches the limit without SET.
hard_stop.action: Stop the sweep and classify no-SET; do not raise voltage within this run.

provenance.text: Symmetric first reset bound derived from the related sub-volt cycling study; exact selected-stack behavior remains to be measured.

hard_stop.condition: Negative sweep reaches the limit without RESET.
hard_stop.action: Stop the sweep and classify no-RESET; do not increase magnitude within this run.

provenance.text: Pre-breakdown ceiling retained until the exact stack's distribution is measured.

hard_stop.condition: Absolute terminal voltage reaches the ceiling.
hard_stop.action: Open the output relay and mark the cell electrically overstressed.

provenance.text: First rung of a bounded filament-size screen.

hard_stop.condition: Current reaches compliance.
hard_stop.action: Clamp current and finish the pulse without increasing compliance automatically.

provenance.text: Second rung used only after the low-compliance cell remains reversible.

hard_stop.condition: Low-compliance reversibility gate has not passed or current reaches this compliance.
hard_stop.action: Do not enter or exceed the mid rung; clamp and preserve the state trace.

provenance.text: Maximum first-coupon rung, below the highest currents reported for the related stack.

hard_stop.condition: Prior rungs have not passed or current reaches the maximum compliance.
hard_stop.action: Do not increase compliance; terminate on a hard short or irreversible state.

provenance.text: Midpoint on a broad useful-conductance screen; measured conductance remains primary.

hard_stop.condition: ON conductance is outside range or cannot be reset.
hard_stop.action: Reject the cell from reliability cycling.

provenance.text: Related Ag/Ag-Ge-S/W cycling maintained an OFF/ON resistance ratio above this value.

hard_stop.condition: Measured conductance-state ratio falls below the minimum.
hard_stop.action: Reject the cell from the admitted reliability population.

provenance.text: One-day first-coupon retention screen; not a mission-lifetime claim.

hard_stop.condition: A spontaneous state change occurs during the hold.
hard_stop.action: Reject the cell and preserve it for endpoint analysis.

provenance.text: First screen uses the established GSFC thermal-vacuum pressure class; mission qualification remains tailored.

hard_stop.condition: Chamber pressure exceeds the maximum after stabilization.
hard_stop.action: Pause electrical cycling and do not count the interval as vacuum exposure.

provenance.text: Room-temperature air/vacuum falsifier isolates pressure before thermal cycling.

hard_stop.condition: Coupon temperature leaves range or differs between cohorts beyond the recorded control tolerance.
hard_stop.action: Pause and reject the pressure comparison if temperature matching cannot be restored.

provenance.text: Mission-independent component screen only; replaced by mission extrema plus margin before qualification.

hard_stop.condition: Temperature undershoots the screen minimum or a mission claim is made from this generic limit.
hard_stop.action: Stop the ramp or block mission promotion, respectively.

provenance.text: Mission-independent component screen only; replaced by mission extrema plus margin before qualification.

hard_stop.condition: Temperature overshoots the screen maximum or a mission claim is made from this generic limit.
hard_stop.action: Stop the ramp or block mission promotion, respectively.

provenance.text: GSFC workmanship-oriented starting count; mission and project verification remain controlling.

hard_stop.condition: Fewer complete cycles finish without protocol violation.
hard_stop.action: Do not pass the thermal-vacuum gate.

provenance.text: Controlled first-coupon ramp equivalent to approximately two kelvin per minute.

hard_stop.condition: Measured ramp magnitude exceeds the maximum.
hard_stop.action: Pause the ramp and do not count the affected transition.

provenance.text: One-hour stabilized dwell supports a read and one programming sequence at each extreme.

hard_stop.condition: Dwell is shorter than the minimum or temperature is not stabilized.
hard_stop.action: Do not count the plateau or its electrical measurements.

provenance.text: Matched first-screen group size from the calibration plan.

hard_stop.condition: Fewer valid air cells complete the protocol.
hard_stop.action: Do not compare cohorts.

provenance.text: Matched first-screen group size from the calibration plan.

hard_stop.condition: Fewer valid vacuum cells complete the protocol.
hard_stop.action: Do not compare cohorts.

provenance.text: Smallest bounded pressure-screen sequence; not an endurance qualification.

hard_stop.condition: A hard short occurs or a cell loses reversible switching.
hard_stop.action: Stop that cell and preserve it for endpoint analysis.

provenance.text: Predeclared first-screen rejection threshold.

hard_stop.condition: Vacuum-cell failure count exceeds the maximum.
hard_stop.action: Reject the stack at the vacuum gate.

provenance.text: Predeclared allowable shift in median SET voltage or ON conductance between air and vacuum cohorts.

hard_stop.condition: Either median fractional drift exceeds the maximum.
hard_stop.action: Reject the stack at the vacuum gate.

provenance.text: Conservative first-screen state-stability ceiling.

hard_stop.condition: Observed spontaneous-switch rate exceeds the ceiling.
hard_stop.action: Reject the stack from reliability admission.

provenance.text: Calibrated violet starting wavelength for Ag photodoping; dose must be established on witness coupons.

hard_stop.condition: Peak wavelength is outside range or witness-coupon Ag profile is unmeasured.
hard_stop.action: Do not fabricate the reliability cohort.

provenance.text: External optoelectronic addressing wavelength; photons command a bounded electrical pulse rather than directly steering the buried filament.

hard_stop.condition: Address wavelength or optical-to-electrical calibration is outside its characterized range.
hard_stop.action: Disable optical addressing and use direct electrical calibration only.

provenance.text: First logarithmic materials-screen point; it is not a mission requirement.

hard_stop.condition: Dosimetry cannot bound absorbed dose at the device or a hard short appears.
hard_stop.action: Stop exposure for the affected cohort.

provenance.text: Second logarithmic materials-screen point; it is not a mission requirement.

hard_stop.condition: Prior dose step was not electrically characterized or a hard short appears.
hard_stop.action: Do not proceed to this or a higher dose step.

provenance.text: Intermediate materials-screen point; it is not a mission requirement.

hard_stop.condition: Prior dose step was not electrically characterized or a hard short appears.
hard_stop.action: Do not proceed to this or a higher dose step.

provenance.text: Upper materials screen matches the order of the published greater-than-one-megarad exposure; it is not a mission requirement.

hard_stop.condition: Prior dose step was not electrically characterized or a hard short appears.
hard_stop.action: Do not proceed to this dose; preserve the lower-dose endpoint.

provenance.text: Predeclared materials-screen ceiling because published in-situ work found pulse-programmed conductance change more sensitive than DC I-V.

hard_stop.condition: Programming efficacy drift exceeds the ceiling at or below the later mission dose.
hard_stop.action: Reject mission admission; continue higher-dose characterization only as a labeled failure study.

provenance.text: Requires mission orbit, duration, shielding, and device location; the materials-screen dose cannot substitute for it.

hard_stop.condition: Mission TID remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block space qualification and any mission-reliability claim.

provenance.text: Heavy-ion species, spectrum, shielding, circuit state, and acceptable cross-section are mission-specific.

hard_stop.condition: Mission SEE LET threshold remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block SEE test definition and space qualification.

provenance.text: Required fluence follows the mission environment and acceptable event-rate confidence, neither of which is defined.

hard_stop.condition: Mission heavy-ion fluence remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block SEE test execution and space qualification.

provenance.text: Particle spectrum, shielding, and equivalent-damage convention require a defined mission.

hard_stop.condition: Mission displacement-damage fluence remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block displacement-damage test definition and space qualification.

provenance.text: Retention, cycling, TID, and spontaneous-switch budgets depend on a defined service lifetime.

hard_stop.condition: Mission lifetime remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block lifetime scaling and space qualification.

provenance.text: Device-local shielding is needed to translate external environment into absorbed dose and particle spectrum.

hard_stop.condition: Device-local shielding areal density remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block environment transport and space qualification.

provenance.text: NASA verification limits derive from expected mission temperature plus margin; the generic screen cannot fill this value.

hard_stop.condition: Mission operational minimum remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block mission-tailored thermal-vacuum qualification.

provenance.text: NASA verification limits derive from expected mission temperature plus margin; the generic screen cannot fill this value.

hard_stop.condition: Mission operational maximum remains unset.
hard_stop.action: Block mission-tailored thermal-vacuum qualification.

gates.description: Establish bounded SET, RESET, conductance ratio, and reservoir accounting on the exact capped stack.
gates.pass: Exact-stack cells switch reversibly without hard short, inventory violation, or voltage-ceiling breach.
gates.fail: Reject the fabrication cohort before vacuum work.

gates.description: Compare matched air and vacuum cells at room temperature before thermal or radiation expense.
gates.pass: Failure count and median pressure-induced drift remain within limits with no hard short.
gates.fail: Reject the stack or cap and preserve endpoint specimens.

gates.description: Run the generic materials thermal-vacuum screen without presenting it as mission qualification.
gates.pass: All counted cycles complete with reversible switching and no cap or reservoir failure.
gates.fail: Reject the stack from radiation screening unless continued as a labeled failure study.

gates.description: Measure active-program and unbiased-retention behavior through the proposed cobalt-60 materials screen.
gates.pass: No hard short occurs and programming efficacy remains within the declared materials-screen limit through relevant dose steps.
gates.fail: Reject mission admission; higher exposure may continue only as an explicit failure characterization.

gates.description: Require mission environment, lifetime, shielding, thermal limits, TID, SEE, and displacement-damage values before qualification planning.
gates.pass: Every required-unset gate is replaced by a traceable mission value and tailored test rationale.
gates.fail: Block space qualification and mission-reliability claims.

gates.description: Admit the exact stack only after material screens and mission-tailored gates pass.
gates.pass: All prior gates pass on the exact stack with complete mass, energy, environment, and failure records.
gates.fail: Keep the manifest in candidate or rejected state.
